annotations.title: Look up an ADA Title II website accessibility report

description: Look up a US local-government (.gov) domain in the CivicBinder Municipal Web Accessibility Index. Returns the accessibility grade (A-F), WCAG 2.1 AA violation counts from an axe-core scan, the failing rules, the entity's ADA Title II compliance deadline (April 2027 or April 2028), and a link to the full public report page. Use for questions like "is cityofx.gov ADA compliant" or "how accessible is this county website".

domain.description: The .gov domain to look up, e.g. "denvergov.org" or "cityofmadison.com". Protocol and paths are stripped automatically.
